categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Solartron Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polymer functional films including reflective films, optical base films, lithium-ion battery separators, and other special functional films. These products are widely applied in liquid crystal displays, power batteries and energy storage, and solar photovoltaic industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer film technologies such as biaxial stretching of polyester films, precision coating, multi-layer polymer and metal film composite technologies, and proprietary formula designs to achieve high reflectivity and optical performance. It also develops electrolyte base membranes for solid and semi-solid batteries with high porosity and compressibility, and employs customized production lines and equipment designed in-house to reduce costs and improve product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international panel and terminal manufacturers such as Samsung Electronics, LG, BOE, and Innolux. The company serves industries in flat panel displays (LCD, Mini LED), semiconductor lighting, new energy vehicles, energy storage, and solar photovoltaic sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with subsidiaries in Ningbo, Shanghai, Hefei, and Zhoushan, and has an overseas sales subsidiary in Hong Kong. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, including significant exports to South Korea and other markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Solartron Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of specialized polymer films and membranes that serve as critical components for downstream electronics, energy storage, and photovoltaic product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance core product competitiveness and develop strategic emerging businesses. Key R&D directions include improving reflective and optical films, advancing solid and semi-solid electrolyte base membranes, and developing transparent polyimide films (CPI) for flexible OLED applications. It aims to achieve import substitution and technological leadership in functional films over the next decade.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of functional films and membranes. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by selected distributors to broaden market reach and customer base.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in reflective films with the largest shipment area worldwide, competing with international giants such as Toray, Teijin, and SKC. It holds a strong domestic position in optical base films and lithium battery separators, striving to narrow the technology gap with foreign competitors and achieve import substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.34 billion, a 6.62% increase year-over-year, but recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 29.44 million due to capacity ramp-up costs and intensified competition. Total assets reached RMB 3.38 billion with a slight growth of 1.37%. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, accounting for 4.61% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ningbo Solartron Technology differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies, including advanced polymer film formulations and in-house designed production equipment that reduce costs and improve product quality. Its reflective films achieve international leading reflectivity levels above 97%, and its electrolyte base membranes offer breakthrough performance improvements for solid-state batteries. The company focuses on high-quality, customized solutions to meet diverse customer needs in emerging technology sectors.
